process_timing.scope: same qualified task/population cells and equal repetition weighting as the unchanged primary search metric

native_call_cost.scope: native call wall includes child, Python/JSON and lock wait; controller CPU may overlap child wall and must not be added to it; cost coverage is not audit success

recovery.correction: copy old speed state before assigning new PID; attempt1 launched no audit
recovery.cause: controller and child absent; no terminal log; cause unproven
recovery.policy: never rerun any existing audit or search; preserve interrupted failure

native_recovery.scope: interrupted rows remain unknown; successful sibling audits do not replace missing evidence

selected_development.selection_bias_note: used to select the global candidate; development G8/R1, not independent validation or a primary target qualification

quality_search_timing.scope: fresh quality workload, actual training cases per task; paired search-function times; all generation/final champion train/test audits, not full final-population CPU/AST coverage; does not replace C1024 primary speed grid
quality_search_timing.weighting: equal frozen tasks and equal paired seeds; overall mean withheld if any pair is unknown
quality_search_timing.range_scope: observed seed ratio range is descriptive, not a confidence interval

target_gap_note: 目前全題計時觀測為1.477×，未達2×。若固定本輪基準與工作量，候選版搜尋時間的幾何平均仍需再降低26.1%才達標。這是距離目標的算術換算，不是新優化已能取得的收益；完整核對不足時仍只能列計時觀測。
